blocks.text: Why Excel remains essential for financial planners

You spend your day moving data between custodians and planning software. Excel acts as the bridge for custom calculations that off-the-shelf tools cannot handle. It provides the flexibility to run custom scenarios for high-net-worth clients.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for Mac users
These shortcuts save minutes every hour. They reduce the need to reach for your mouse or trackpad. If a shortcut conflicts with macOS, check System Settings > Keyboard > Shortcuts.

Financial models grow quickly. You might hit the limit of 1,048,576 rows. Keep your files fast by using tables instead of open ranges. This ensures your formulas only calculate the data present. Use XLOOKUP instead of VLOOKUP for better performance and flexibility.

blocks.text: How to handle data formatting issues

Excel often strips leading zeros from account numbers or zip codes. Force Excel to treat these as text by adding an apostrophe before the number. You can also format the column as Text before pasting data.

faq.question: Can I use Excel for Mac for all my financial planning needs?
faq.answer: Excel is excellent for custom analysis, but you should use specialized platforms like RightCapital or eMoney for compliance-heavy financial planning.

faq.question: How do I speed up slow Excel files?
faq.answer: Remove unused formatting, convert ranges to tables, and avoid volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET where possible.
